name: Skill Expert
summary: +1 to any ability; gain one skill proficiency and Expertise in one skill you are proficient in.

benefits.name: Skill Proficiency
benefits.summary: Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
benefits.text: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

benefits.name: Expertise
benefits.summary: Gain Expertise in one skill you are proficient in.
benefits.text: Choose one skill in which you have proficiency but lack Expertise. You gain Expertise in that skill.
